title: QoS preset chips double-scale their x offset — the 3rd chip overflows the panel card at x1.25 (+48px) and x1.50 (+126px)
detail: w is computed in already-scaled space (hud(QOS_PANEL_W)), then i*(w+4) is passed through hud() a SECOND time. With 3 lane_presets at x1.50: chip x = 30/243/456, w=138 — chip 2 spans 456..594 while the panel spans 18..468. Violates E9.3 'chrome stays legible at each step'.
recommended_fix: Compute the chip x in scaled space without re-scaling: x0 := hud(QOS_PANEL_X+8); return {f32(x0 + i*(w + hud(4))), ...} so chips tile inside the scaled panel.

title: QoS panel draw-side leftovers unscaled: weight value renders ON the scaled [-] button and the proportion bar renders over the lane label at x1.25/x1.50
evidence:
bw := i32((QOS_PANEL_W - 150) * u64(caps[lane]) / max(1, total))
		if bw > 0 {
			rl.DrawRectangle(QOS_PANEL_X + 118, y + 7, bw, 8, cols[lane])
...
			x := QOS_PANEL_X + 8 + lane * 96
...
			draw_text(app, wv, i32(x + 44), y + 4, 14, p.ink)
detail: qos_nudge_rect now scales (B5), but the editor row's x and the wv value text stay unscaled: at x1.50 lane 0 the [-] button spans x60..90 while wv draws at x64 — text over the button. The scaled lane label (hud(15) font at hud(22)) overruns the unscaled bar at x=130. PR B5 claims no x1.25/x1.50 overlap.
recommended_fix: Route the editor-row x (x := rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_X + 8 + lane*96)), the wv offset/font, and the proportion bar (x, y+7, h=8, bw base) through hud()/hud_f() like the rects.

title: still present since round 1: SLA gauge rows scale the text but not the 16px row pitch or the 740x18 hit rect — overlapping lines + hit drift at x1.25+
detail: hud(16) text (24px at x1.50) on an unscaled 16px pitch overlaps consecutive gauge rows by ~8px; the focus hit rect stays 740x18. E9.3: 'UI/gauge scaling (the settings knob; chrome stays legible at each step)'. r1 warning, not reworked.
recommended_fix: Scale sla_row_y's pitch and origin and sla_row_rect's width/height through hud() (draw + hit share both procs, so one edit each).

title: still present since round 1: draw_hud top-left + game-over blocks use scaled fonts on unscaled y anchors — title/hint and toast/retry rows overlap at x1.50
evidence:
draw_text(app, "Packet Plumber - v2", 12, 10, rnd.hud(&app.view, 22), p.ink)
...
				draw_text(app, "SURGE SURVIVED - YOU WIN", 12, 68, rnd.hud(&app.view, 30), rl.Color{44, 134, 66, 255})
...
		draw_text(app, "press R or Enter to retry (fresh run, fresh seed)", 12, 104, rnd.hud(&app.view, 16), p.ink_soft)
...
		draw_text(app, "click to place; ESC / right-click cancels", 12, 36, rnd.hud(&app.view, 14), p.ink)
detail: At x1.50 the 33px title (y10..43) overlaps the hint row (y36); the 45px toast (y68..113) overlaps the retry hint (y104). r1 warning ('scale the y anchors through hud()') not reworked; E9.3 chrome-legible AC fails at the knob's max.
recommended_fix: Pass the y anchors (10/36/56/68/76/104) through rnd.hud() or derive each row from the previous row's scaled height.

title: still present since round 1: demolish popover scales width/insets but not height or text — the button rides up over the pipe-popover title at x1.25+
detail: h (POPOVER_H_PIPE=64) and all popover text stay unscaled while the button inset scales: at x1.50 the button top = pop.y+64-54 = y+10, covering the title at y+8..23 (drawn before the button). r1 warning, not reworked; hit-test stays consistent (shared rects).
recommended_fix: Scale the popover heights and the title/button text through hud_f()/hud() (POPOVER_H_NODE/H_PIPE at the call sites or inside popover_rect).

title: still present since round 1: panel opened while placement is armed leaves the mouse dead on the panel — ui-press stays gated on placing_eff < 0
detail: Pad Y (or S with no selection) opens the panel mid-placement; mouse left-presses then skip on_ui_press (placing gate) and the panel-open branch suppresses the rest — rows/chip unclickable until Esc. Touch/keyboard unaffected (touch calls on_ui_press directly). Mixed-device edge of the input-parity guard.
recommended_fix: While inp.panel_open, invoke on_ui_press regardless of placing_eff (the modal owns the surface, like the touch path).

title: Panel footer 'S / tap chip to close' is false when the panel was opened with a pipe selected — S is never collected with sel_pipe >= 0
detail: Open the panel via pad Y or a chip tap while a pipe is selected: S is dropped at collection (sel_pipe >= 0) and phase-2 is blocked by panel_open, so S is a no-op — the footer's close hint fails. Esc still closes. Input-parity surface text vs behavior mismatch.
recommended_fix: While panel_open, collect S regardless of sel_pipe (phase-2 is already panel-gated), or change the footer to 'Esc / tap chip to close'.
